_about: Answers of POST /api/saved_objects/_import of Kibana 9.5.4 (VM tpot-e2e-installer, 2026-10-15), each for a file of two objects. When an answer holds errors, Kibana wrote none of the objects: successResults names the objects it would have written, they stayed missing (GET 404). Without errors every object is written.

conflict_overwrite_false._file: tag a (exists in Kibana) and tag b (missing), overwrite=false: a stays as it was, b is NOT created

conflict_only._file: dashboard only (exists in Kibana), overwrite=false: unchanged

missing_reference_overwrite_true._file: dashboard good (no references) and dashboard bad (a reference to a missing index-pattern), overwrite=true: neither is created

not_multipart._file: a body of application/json instead of multipart/form-data: HTTP 415
